parameters.name: shift_id
parameters.description: The shift the labour plan is for (the planner's shift identifier, also carried by workforce-management's shift plan).

parameters.name: path_id
parameters.description: The process path code: case-insensitive; stored and published in upper case (trimmed), so "pick" and "PICK" name the same forecast and labour plan. Upper-cased, it also names the facility-tally activity whose stations the labour plan's warning compares with.
